_comment: Pre-registered 30-query labelled set for road-to-reachable-code-memory Phase 9 D3 (intent-conditioned verb selection). Written and frozen BEFORE src/scripts/code_graph/intent.ts existed — see the D3 evidence note in agents/evidence/reports/. Each `verb` is the human-judged CORRECT code_graph subcommand for the natural-language `question`, independent of any keyword the router might later use. Labels are NOT tuned to any regex — they reflect genuine intent: `query` = direct (1-hop) relations of a seed, `affected` = reverse lookup (who calls/uses/would break), `path` = connectivity/reachability between two seeds, `explain` = a broader neighbourhood/overview around a seed.

always_query_baseline.description: The pre-D3 default verb every ambiguous natural-language ask maps to today.
